title: Prevent false PROVEN labels on canonical tenant Brain learning projection
root_cause: Protected main #4673 counted healthy=true and status=ok as proven even when no actual provider/production receipt existed; authenticated runtime mapper flattened source PROVEN into ok while discarding evidence. Real tenant impact is unverified.
prevention_rule: For every agent and tenant portal, PROVEN requires authoritative PROVEN maturity plus explicit actual production/provider readback and immutable allowlisted source receipt from the existing authenticated Brain projection. Successful transport status or a green test fixture alone is never proof; retain occurrence fingerprint and negative regression.
failed_approaches: Original #4673 test fixture asserted a green label from status ok + healthy true with no proof.
Tenant runtime mapper dropped original source maturity and evidence reference.
fix: Preserve evidence reference, source maturity, and actual productionVerified flag in portal-v2/runtime-evidence.js.
Require the three proof fields before any Bewezen in Brain label and fail closed on missing / untrusted proof.
Add positive and negative regressions and preserve the existing skill and ledger.
owner: Existing Portal V2 Relevantie/Powerhouse self-improvement owner; corrective successor to merged #4673

invariants: no success label for healthy+ok without PROVEN and receipt
no proof without explicit production/provider readback
no second scheduler or data authority

terminal_rule: Only exact-head protected Required+CodeQL, main merge, matching production Netlify deploy and independent authenticated tenant evidence justify final closure; do not claim all 321/355 other incidents solved.
